create.name: Dr. Laura Koniver
create.bio:
Trained in conventional medicine, Dr. Laura Koniver is a physician who later moved to a holistic approach centred on grounding, the practice of being in direct physical contact with the Earth. Her book The Earth Prescription (Reveal Press, 2020) collects grounding practices for every season and has been translated into several languages. She has featured in documentaries on grounding, among them The Earthing Movie, Down to Earth, Heal for Free and The Grounded. She also paints and writes a regular column for MaryJanesFarm magazine.

She explains grounding in plain language: why the body's electrical connection with the ground matters to her, easy ways to ground indoors and outdoors through the seasons, and how to make the practice part of everyday life. As The Intuition Physician she shares hundreds of short teaching videos, guided grounding meditations and online classes on intuition and the chakras, and she runs small in-person grounding retreats in the eastern United States. She also offers free events and online courses on The Shift Network.

books.title: The Earth Prescription: Discover the Healing Power of Nature with Grounding Practices for Every Season
books.author: Laura Koniver
books.description: A practical guide to grounding, the practice of touching the Earth directly with bare skin. It offers dozens of grounding practices arranged by season, for outdoors and indoors, along with the author's account of why the practice matters to her.

courses.title: Chakra Alignment Online Healing Class
courses.description: A self-paced seven-week online course that spends a week on each of the seven chakras, from root to crown. Each week includes a self-assessment, video lessons, journalling exercises, yoga poses and meditations.

courses.title: Expanding Your Intuition Class
courses.description: A self-paced online class on recognising and strengthening your own intuition, including for people who see themselves as empaths. Laura shares how she opened to intuitive guidance and how to make decisions from it.

courses.title: The Earth & Universe Grounding Meditations Collection
courses.description: Seven guided meditations to listen to while grounded: one for each season, plus Waterfall, Mountain and You Are A Living Universe. They focus on relaxation, renewal and a sense of connection with the natural world.

courses.title: Intuitive Expansion: Grounding Meditations To Connect You To Your Intuition
courses.description: Three guided grounding meditations of 12 to 16 minutes: finding your intuitive type, receiving intuitions, and working with your intuitive connection to others while keeping healthy boundaries.

courses.title: Nature's Rhythm: Spring, Summer, Fall & Winter Grounding Meditations
courses.description: Four short seasonal meditations, each five to six minutes, designed to be heard while grounded outdoors or indoors. Each one draws on the qualities of its season, from growth and vitality to reflection and rest.

free_resources.title: Grounding Your Electrical Body
free_resources.description: A free hour-long video event on The Shift Network, available as a recording. Laura explains why she sees the body's electrical connection with the Earth as important and leads a guided grounding practice with mindful breathing and body awareness.

flags: Physician whose grounding work is presented mainly as health care; most of her own pages and many videos make health claims, so only neutral items were kept. A human should confirm the page is acceptable for a strict health-claim policy.

Free event 'Grounding Your Electrical Body' kept as borderline: its landing page mentions fatigue, poor sleep and the body's 'natural healing processes', though the event itself is a guided grounding practice; our description avoids those claims.
Video 'How Quickly Does Grounding Affect Your Body' has a neutral title but discusses physical effects of grounding; kept, check if stricter handling is wanted.
She describes herself as a 'medical intuitive' on her About page; that wording is left out of the bio.
Name given as 'Dr. Laura Koniver' (Spiritpedia style); she is known as Laura Koniver, MD / The Intuition Physician.
Video titles had a trailing '(Laura Koniver, MD... The Intuition Physician)' style tag, removed like a channel-name suffix.
YouTube channel avatar is a logo (heart with caduceus), not used.
left_out: Shift course 'Bioelectric Healing' ($1,799 USD, started 16 Sep 2026): course page promises relief of chronic pain and trauma recovery.

Her in-person grounding retreats (Spring Renewal April 2026 – past; Fall Reset Sep 2026 – past; Silent Retreat April 2027; Winter Guided Grounding Retreat, undated): product pages promise to release inflammation and old health issues and 'restore your health'.
Private consultation via Zoom: one-to-one medical consultation, not her main teaching format.

Online classes named for conditions or health outcomes: Electrosensitivity (EHS) Relief, Trauma Recovery & Resilience, Weight Release & Reset, Adrenal Repair, Skin Happiness, Gentle Restart Detox, Health Flow Unleash; several also dated in the past.

Free eBooks (Grounding Idea, Chakra Radiance, Female Health, Parenting For Your Child's Health, Skin Happiness) and FREE Earth Connect class: descriptions claim effects on immunity, inflammation, blood sugar or disease states.
Meditations named for health outcomes (Trauma Release, Deep Sleep, Positive Aging) left out; other $9 single meditations not listed to keep the list short.

Popular videos left out for health claims or condition names: deep sleep tips, chronic disease, weight loss, adrenal fatigue, electrohypersensitivity, heart/blood/circulation, muscles & bones, brain and sleep, anxiety, trauma relief, gut health, inflammation, stem cells/longevity.
Children's picture books (From The Ground Up, Open To Possibilities, Sleep Easy) sold on her own shop; no Amazon ASIN verified.
Amazon search pages could not be read, so other books (if any) were not verified.
